hard_gates.name: zero-provider-use
hard_gates.evidence: The original contract tests were network-free.

hard_gates.name: public-gold-separation
hard_gates.evidence: The original public case did not contain expected action fields.

hard_gates.name: flow-independent-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: The original callback boundary exposed events, time, restart, actions, and state.

hard_gates.name: complete-finite-portfolio
hard_gates.evidence: The original contract covered one synthetic condition and two durations, not the frozen four-condition portfolio.

hard_gates.name: privacy-safe-operational-lineage
hard_gates.evidence: The original response exposed only aggregate zero-valued operational fields.

hard_gates.name: zero-provider-use
hard_gates.evidence: The 820-case reference simulation made zero provider calls and incurred zero tokens or cost.

hard_gates.name: public-gold-separation
hard_gates.evidence: Every public case excludes expected action, terminal state, and required-invariant fields; public and gold hashes differ.

hard_gates.name: flow-independent-boundary
hard_gates.evidence: Scoring consumes observable events, actions, state, diagnostic invariants, and operational metrics without graph or storage internals.

hard_gates.name: complete-finite-portfolio
hard_gates.evidence: The deterministic package contains exactly 600 trajectory, 100 long-horizon, and 120 proactive-opportunity cases.

hard_gates.name: privacy-safe-operational-lineage
hard_gates.evidence: Per-call rows include bounded task, identity, token, latency, cost, status, and error fields and exclude prompt content.

decision.rationale: Use the candidate harness for #157 because it preserves the flow-independent boundary while adding the complete frozen condition portfolio, deterministic hard-gate scoring, public/gold isolation, and prospective per-call operational accounting. This selects evaluation infrastructure only and does not select T1-v2.1 for release.
limitations: The reference driver is deterministic and scripted; its perfect rates are not product-quality evidence.
No provider-backed product adapter, held-out factual tranche, professor reference, external human, or learning outcome was evaluated.
T1-v2.1 remains unselected and T1-v1/T0 remain control and rollback.
